latest.description: Natural Earth 10m countries. Morocco and Western Sahara merged into one polygon.

1991_ceasefire.description: Natural Earth 10m map units. Morocco and Western Sahara are separate polygons. Use for ceasefire/disputed-territory scenes.

ne_10m_sovereignty.description: Natural Earth 10m sovereignty units. Distinguishes sovereign states from dependent territories (e.g. Western Sahara under Moroccan sovereignty).

ne_50m_countries.description: Natural Earth 50m countries. Lower resolution (~5x smaller than 10m), faster render. Good for wide-angle and global overview scenes.

ne_110m_countries.description: Natural Earth 110m countries. Minimal geometry detail. Best for planetary overview shots where fine borders are invisible anyway.
